newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 11,800 MT were primarily the result of increases for Egypt (90,600 MT), Taiwan (54,300 MT), Morocco (27,300 MT), and Venezuela (26,400 MT) being more than offset by reductions for Japan (142,000 MT), unknown destinations (76,500 MT), and Israel (41,500 MT).
Sales of 147,700 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for South Korea (84,500 MT).

Exports of 774,300 MT were one-third above the week earlier and one-quarter above the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (227,600 MT), Taiwan (109,200 MT), Egypt (100,600 MT), Spain (67,400 MT), South Korea (55,100 MT), and Indonesia (52,500 MT).
